description: This PHP source file defines a function `additionalDetailsProjectTask` used to generate additional details display for a project task, including constructing an overlib HTML string with various task fields and returning links for editing and viewing the task. It appears to be part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically for handling metadata related to project tasks.

methods.name: additionalDetailsProjectTask
methods.description: Generates an array containing HTML snippets and links for displaying additional project task details based on provided fields.
